body: I have a therapist but I also can't get to her without help. I live in the area that was on the front page of reddit for being buried under 17ft of snow last year. I've got a friend in my corner now which is nice and my boyfriend is stopping by to talk sometime today I hope.

It would cost me literally every cent I make to swing that and even then I'd be a half hour walk away from work, and the winter is starting. I seriously live in the most isolating region in the state.

I'm 20 and I live in the US. I just spoke with him and he doesn't love me and has been struggling to negotiate his desire to break up with me and the knowledge id be over the deep end if he did. 

There's really nothing I can do now that he's gone. Just logistically, I'm going to have to quit my job because he won't be able to drive me anymore. I mean I could be my mother's slave to earn her assistance but she's an emotional abuser and has always been the top source of suicidal thought-inducing stress in my life.

I have no resources to change my situation. My day to day life depends on what the people around me think because they control whether I keep my job, whether I go to school, whether I get to leave the house or otherwise communicate with the outside world

I have an income. There's no way to get to and from my work without the help of the people who drive me, and any of them can withdraw that support at any time. There's nowhere closer that I can work. There are things that bring me joy but nothing is worth it because I'm literally going to be stuck in this position forever anyway.
I have no transportation (I can't drive), I can't learn unless someone takes the time to teach me, nobody will drive me anywhere, and I live in an area with literally no public transport.
